import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
import statsmodels.api as sm

# 1. Load clinical data and compute BMI
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
clin = clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'height_cm', 'weight_kg', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender']]
clin.rename(columns={'bcr_patient_barcode': 'patient_id'}, inplace=True)
clin = clin.dropna(subset=['height_cm', 'weight_kg', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender'])
clin['height_cm'] = pd.to_numeric(clin['height_cm'], errors='coerce')
clin['weight_kg'] = pd.to_numeric(clin['weight_kg'], errors='coerce')
clin['age_at_diagnosis'] = pd.to_numeric(clin['age_at_diagnosis'], errors='coerce')
clin = clin.dropna(subset=['height_cm', 'weight_kg', 'age_at_diagnosis'])
clin['BMI'] = clin['weight_kg'] / (clin['height_cm'] / 100) ** 2

# 2. Load gene expression and extract LEP using known Ensembl ID prefix
ensembl_lep_prefix = 'ENSG00000174697'
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
lep_mask = expr.index.str.startswith(ensembl_lep_prefix)
if lep_mask.sum() == 0:
    raise ValueError('LEP Ensembl ID not found')
lep_series = expr.loc[lep_mask].iloc[0]

# 3. Average LEP expression by patient
lep_df = lep_series.reset_index()
lep_df.columns = ['sample_id', 'LEP_expr']
lep_df['patient_id'] = lep_df['sample_id'].str[:12]
lep_patient = lep_df.groupby('patient_id', as_index=False)['LEP_expr'].mean()

# 4. Merge datasets
df = pd.merge(clin, lep_patient, on='patient_id', how='inner')

# 5. Scatter plot and correlations
pearson_r, pearson_p = pearsonr(df['BMI'], df['LEP_expr'])
spearman_rho, spearman_p = spearmanr(df['BMI'], df['LEP_expr'])
plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sns.scatterplot(x='BMI', y='LEP_expr', data=df)
plt.title(f'BMI vs LEP expr\nPearson r={pearson_r:.2f} (p={pearson_p:.3f}), Spearman rho={spearman_rho:.2f} (p={spearman_p:.3f})')
plt.xlabel('BMI')
plt.ylabel('LEP expression (log2)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 6. Prepare regression variables and ensure numeric types
df['gender_male'] = (df['gender'].str.upper() == 'MALE').astype(int)
df['age'] = df['age_at_diagnosis'].astype(float)
df['BMI'] = df['BMI'].astype(float)
df['LEP_expr'] = df['LEP_expr'].astype(float)

# Build design matrix X and outcome y
X = df[['BMI', 'age', 'gender_male']]
X = sm.add_constant(X)
y = df['LEP_expr']

# 7. Fit OLS model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
print(model.summary())

# 8. Residual diagnostics
resid = model.resid
fitted = model.fittedvalues

plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sm.qqplot(resid, line='s', ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('QQ Plot of Residuals')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sns.scatterplot(x=fitted, y=resid)
plt.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Fitted values')
plt.ylabel('Residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sns.histplot(resid, kde=True)
plt.title('Histogram of Residuals')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 9. Display merged data sample
default_cols = ['patient_id','BMI','LEP_expr','age','gender']
print('Merged data sample:')
print(df[default_cols].head())
